# package codegen

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-canbus/codegen"
```

Package codegen generates Go code from a candb.Database: one struct per message with typed raw fields, identifier and length constants, enum types for value descriptions, physical-value accessors, and multiplexer-aware Encode, Decode and Frame methods.

The output is deterministic (no timestamps, the database's order), gofmt-formatted and carries its provenance: the source name, the SHA-256 of the source and the generator version. It imports only the standard library, github.com/otfabric/go-canbus and its small candb/bits runtime.

## Constants

```go
const Version = "2"
```

Version identifies the generator in the provenance header. It changes when the generated code changes.

## Functions

### func Generate

```go
func Generate(db *candb.Database, opts Options) ([]byte, error)
```

Generate returns the Go source for db. The database must validate without errors.

### func GenerateJSON

```go
func GenerateJSON(db *candb.Database, opts Options) ([]byte, error)
```

GenerateJSON returns the database as an indented JSON descriptor for dynamic consumers (the candb model's JSON form, with provenance).

## Types

### type Options

```go
type Options struct {
	// Package is the Go package name (required).
	Package string
	// Source names the database file in the provenance header.
	Source string
	// SourceSHA256 is the hex SHA-256 of the database file, if known.
	SourceSHA256 string
}
```

Options control generation.
